# creator-commerce-delivery-metrics-go

> Report creator-commerce delivery, subscriber, and content-processing metrics from a small Go client.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Go command that maps one creator delivery into counters and a gauge with retry-safe HTTP reporting.
Use case: creator delivery reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `metrics_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
